description: Press the restart button as many times as necessary #LifeByDesign #nervoussystemhealing #restarting
transcript: We are allowed to press the restart button as many times as necessary. I will not stay in a space longer than I need to just because my ego tells me that strength comes from sitting and enduring things that I shouldn't or wouldn't in any other normal circumstance. The decisions and the choices that we make take us into the next decades of our lives and what we do today matters. I no longer try to make puzzle pieces fit, that don't fit. I'm not going to cut and readjust a piece that I found just because I want to have a complete puzzle. This process is never complete, this life is never complete, this life is ever evolving and it is my job to shift.
